remarks: Discover your dream urban oasis in this modern loft-style apartment located in the charming and vibrant community of Wall Street Historic neighborhood. With a blend of contemporary design and historic character, this beautifully renovated space features 12+ foot ceilings, exposed original brick, and tall windows that allow an abundance of natural light that creates an airy, expansive feel throughout the apartment home. The sleek kitchen is outfitted with stainless-steel appliances, including a refrigerator, dishwasher, stove/oven, and microwave, all complemented by modern cabinetry and elegant quartz countertops, ensuring both style and functionality. Convenience is key with an in-unit washer and dryer. The bedrooms allow for plenty of room for furnishings and personal touches, while the modern full-tile bathroom features glass enclosures for a spa-like retreat in the comfort of your home. Additional highlights include off-street parking for one vehicle, with an option for additional vehicle(s), and a high-efficiency HVAC unit for optimal heating and cooling. This apartment home is nestled in a prime central Norwalk neighborhood close to parks, trendy restaurants, shopping along with convenient access to major highways and public transit options, making commuting easy and stress-free. Be part of a small, intimate complex that fosters a sense of community and privacy, with all four units fully renovated with modern finishes and amenities throughout.
